reasoning: The question asks whether Wesley So's Elo rating on 2025-11-02 will be at least 1% higher than on 2025-10-26. According to the evidence, Wesley So's October 2025 FIDE rating was 2756 (from snippet 1). A 1% increase would require a rating of at least 2756 × 1.01 = 2783.56, so he would need to reach 2784+. The November 2025 FIDE rating shows Wesley So at 2756 (snippet 1, Wikipedia table) or 2764 (snippet 3, ChessBase). The FIDE profile (snippet 2) shows 2756 for October 2025 and 2764 for November 2025. The 2764 rating represents an 8-point increase from 2756, which is only 0.29%, well below the 1% threshold needed. Even using the higher November figure of 2764, this falls short of the required 2784. The evidence consistently shows minimal rating change between October and November 2025, with no source indicating a gain of 28+ points needed for a 1% increase.
